## History

Allan, a young and pleasant-faced new minister, arrived in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) while still on his honeymoon with his wife. Shortly after his arrival, he and his wife attended a lavish tea prepared in their honor at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). During the event, [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and Allan's wife discovered that the layer cake baked specially for the occasion tasted strange.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P0](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XXI.
